A '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]] was a major engagement in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEA" />

A large [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic fleet]] went from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Battle of Togoria (Galactic Civil War)|defeated]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc|Teradoc]] in the [[Thanos system|Togoria system]]. After this costly victory, the New Republic forces attacked the [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] Colla IV. The battle was a major victory for the New Republic. This battle allowed the New Republic to return to [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]], in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] abandoned the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa system]] due to the progress of the New Republic forces.<ref name="TEA" />
